newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF SHARES OPEN UP, THEN DROP ON DEUTSCHE.
newsitem.headline: AGF SHARES OPEN UP, THEN DROP ON DEUTSCHE.

text.p: Shares in French insurer AGF opened 2.22 percent up at 221.3 francs but shed most of the opening gains quickly, as Deutsche Bank dismissed a German newspaper report that it wanted to buy AGF as "pure speculation".
AGF's share was trading 0.55 percent higher at 217.7 francs at 0813 GMT.
A Deutsche Bank spokesman said in response to a Reuter query: "that is pure speculation".

He had been asked about a report in German daily Die Welt which said in its Wednesday edition that Deutsche wanted to take over AGF. The report had followed a declaration by Deutsche chief executive Rolf Breuer last month that his bank was considering making an acquisition in France.

AGF has been the subject of on-and-off stock market speculation in recent months both as a possible buyer and possible bid target following the merger of Axa and UAP to form the world's second largest insurer.
